services.value: Provides drinking water testing (Lead, bacteria, and other contaminants), wastewater testing (Industrial and municipal compliance), agricultural water testing (Food safety compliance), recreational water testing (Pools, lakes, and other sources), PFAS testing (Coming Soon), VOC testing (Coming Soon), and heavy metal testing (Routine, advanced, and method development). Also offers IDEXX Microbiology testing (Standard and advanced quantification) and Environmental Chemistry testing, with specialized expanded services for PFAS detection/quantification using advanced LC-QQQ instrumentation and VOC analysis using GC-QQQ systems.
